summary: KLX Energy Services Holdings filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a backstopped rights offering, distributing transferable basic subscription rights to eligible holders of common stock and participating warrants as of August 21, 2026. Each right allows purchase of 3.885 shares at $1.49 per share, targeting approximately $125.0 million aggregate value, with proceeds used to reduce leverage and redeem 2030 Notes. Backstop Parties, existing 2030 Notes holders, commit to purchase up to $94.0 million of unsubscribed shares via a backstop exchange, subject to a 30% ownership limitation. There is no minimum offering amount; watch subscription uptake and potential dilution.
